_schema: 命中任一 trigger → 分类出 topic_group/topic/dimension/emotion/is_transition。dimension 输出通用 Dimension taxonomy；中文 trigger 用子串匹配，英文 trigger 用词/短语边界匹配。单卡 rank 不硬过滤，只用很小的 topic/dimension/emotion/preference/voice 校准。安全信号使用 safety_score/safety_tier: emergency(>=140 或直接命中) 走 911/immediate-danger protocol, crisis(>=80) 走 988/crisis protocol, watch(>=35) 暴露给产品层做温柔确认/资源提示但不硬停普通 RAG。

triggers: someone is going to kill themselves
entries.note: Immediate danger / current action / means / overdose / cannot stay safe / someone else in immediate danger. Use 911 or local emergency services protocol before ordinary crisis resources.
Low-weight generic life-area cue so multi-label prompts can include family without forcing a specific inner dimension.
Low-weight generic life-area cue so multi-label prompts can include friends/community without forcing a specific inner dimension.
Low-weight generic life-area cue. Specific work triggers below still carry stronger dimension/emotion evidence.
Generic money cue; kept low-weight because money can appear with work, family, or daily-life worries.
Generic affect/dimension cue; topic must come from nearby life-area triggers or semantic retrieval.
Generic emotion cue for session multi-labeling; specific source/topic still comes from other triggers or embedding.
Broad work-performance cue for session labeling; specific sales/startup/rejection entries can override with stronger evidence.

triggers: the one project that actually matters
entries.note: Broad self-growth / long-game cue for personal projects, identity, readiness, and creative persistence.
Health/body cue strong enough to beat the generic work trigger in phrases like 'work out'.
Broad family/parenting cue; grief/boundary/parenting-specific entries add stronger dimension evidence.

triggers: gave so much to this relationship
entries.note: Broad relationship cue for prompts that do not use breakup/ghosting/marriage wording.
Modern-life cue for commute and device/feed loops.
Specific social-media/device loop cue; overrides the broader Modern Life bucket.

triggers: running out of energy to begin again
entries.note: Broad setback cue across work, school, love, sport, and creative effort.
Broad confidence/comparison cue when the pain is self-doubt or status comparison.
Decision/direction cue for stuck choice loops.
Slow-progress cue for the long mental game.

triggers: said yes to too many things
entries.note: Overcommitting with resentment is a boundary problem, even when it also feels exhausting.

triggers: feel guilty every time i rest
entries.note: Capacity/recovery cue for depletion and no-room-to-breathe states.
Conflict/boundary cue across family, love, friendship, and work.
Founder/cofounder disagreement should route to work conflict, not generic work pressure.
Attachment/loss cue for fading contact, missing, separation, and difficulty letting go.
Belonging cue for isolation and weak connection.
Meaning/identity cue for existential drift after goals, aging, retirement, or life sameness.

triggers: worry about everything that could go wrong
entries.note: Control/uncertainty cue for waiting, replaying, and fear of future loss.
Performance anxiety in front of an audience is pressure/performance, not interpersonal conflict.
Daily-grounding cue for flat, low-activation, not-quite-sad states.
Generic comparison cue; life area should come from nearby work, friendship, family, social-media, or self signals.
Milestone comparison is usually a self-worth/life-direction problem, even when it appears through a feed.

triggers: criticized me in front of everyone
not good enough for good things

entries.note: Direct suicide/self-harm language. Hard-stop normal retrieval and return the crisis resources card.

triggers: i know how i'll do it
entries.note: Planning, preparation, researching, or final-goodbye signals. Hard-stop normal retrieval.

triggers: 没有继续活下去的理由
go to sleep and not wake up
everyone would be better without me
they would be better without me
entries.note: Passive death-wish / burden language. Treat as crisis for a static card app; do not answer with wisdom content.
Ambiguous but concerning language. One hit creates safety_watch; stacked hits can cross the crisis threshold.

triggers: leading a team for the first time
lost my temper with my kid
work and take care of the baby
entries.note: New-baby overload is usually a capacity problem before it is an abstract responsibility problem.
Phone-scrolling can be Modern Life, but when the pain is self-disappointment after a plan, route to self-discipline.
Money/runway/investment loss is primarily uncertainty, even when startup or work progress words are present.

triggers: trained for months and keep losing
entries.note: Athletic long-game failure is a setback/mental-game case, not only a body-recovery case.
Workout restart loops should keep Health & Body but use discipline rather than recovery.

triggers: come home to an empty place
moved to a new city and have no friends
entries.note: New-city loneliness is belonging before identity.
Parenting self-doubt with a child not listening is lived pressure, not only responsibility.

triggers: make good money but still anxious
still worry money is not enough
entries.note: Enough-but-never-enough money anxiety is attachment/scarcity, not simple performance pressure.

triggers: is this all my life will be
entries.note: Aging/time-horizon worry is life meaning rather than a modern-life card.
Empty win after a project is an identity/meaning signal, not just work pressure.

triggers: failed the exam and everyone else passed
don't know how to face them after failing
entries.note: Academic failure plus comparison is personal setback/comparison before institutional pressure.

triggers: dreading the day before it's even started
entries.note: Morning dread should surface grounding cards, not only recovery cards.
Slow body-change progress should stay health/body but use progress/patience.

triggers: checking how my coworker is doing
每次开会看到他我就难受
entries.note: Coworker comparison should not route to generic conflict.

triggers: my father passed and people tell me to move on
my mother passed and people tell me to move on
entries.note: Parent grief should keep the family context instead of collapsing to generic self-meaning.

triggers: after moving and still too much to do
entries.note: Post-move depletion is body/capacity even when the user says there is too much to do.
Post-decision replay is control/uncertainty, not a fresh decision-choice problem.

triggers: 努力了这么久还是没结果
怀疑坚持到底有没有意义
patient for years and nothing has changed
worked this long with no result
entries.note: Long persistence with no outcome is the core self/long-game case.
Rest guilt is an internal capacity/belief issue, not only health/body fatigue.

triggers: embarrassing thing i said years ago
entries.note: Old embarrassment rumination is regret, not generic confidence comparison.

triggers: running out of energy to begin again
entries.note: Repeated restarts after setbacks are a self/long-game setback case.
Waiting after an application is work uncertainty, not a health/family uncertainty card.
Withholding real opinions is an inner boundary/assertion issue unless a specific relationship context is named.
Exam prep pressure is user mental performance for this product, not career/work by default.
Jealousy toward a friend should keep the friendship context.

triggers: ready and confident before i begin
waiting to feel ready and confident
entries.note: Waiting for confidence is primarily confidence, not slow progress.

triggers: lost my job and my relationship
entries.note: Stacked cross-domain losses should route to whole-life setback, not just work.

triggers: 特别想找个地缝钻进去
made a big mistake at work
criticized by my boss in front of everyone
wanted to disappear after being criticized
entries.note: Public criticism after a work mistake should retrieve setback-repair cards before comparison cards.

triggers: partner and i keep having the same fight
和伴侣总是同样的争吵
entries.note: Repeated partner fights can feel exhausting, but the matching need is conflict/boundaries.

triggers: ask for a raise but i freeze
freeze up every time i imagine the conversation
entries.note: Raise conversations are performance pressure before they are status comparison.

triggers: gave so much to this relationship
this relationship and it still ended
still ended and i don't know how to trust
still ended and i dont know how to trust
付出了很多还是结束了
entries.note: A relationship ending after heavy investment is a setback/trust injury, not only attachment loss.

triggers: do not want to be alive
don't want to be here anymore
dont want to be here anymore
would be better off without me
think im having a heart attack

entries.note: A parent's cognitive decline reads as grief/fear over losing who they were, not family conflict; added after 'dad'/'mom' bare keyword (entry 45) wrongly won this to Conflict & Boundaries/Hurt.

A business/startup that has definitively ended is a completed setback, not ongoing anxious progress; added because the bare 'startup' keyword (entry 101) wrongly won this to Progress & Patience/Anxiety.
A friend relocating is a loss/goodbye moment; the bare 'friend' keyword (entry ~) carries topic_group only, no dimension/emotion, so this closes that gap.

triggers: know what i need to do but
know what to do but can't
know what i should do but
entries.note: Activation-energy paralysis ('I know what to do but can't start'). The literal 拖延/procrastinate entries miss these because words sit between the keywords. Surfaces the Self & Meaning avoided-task cards (31/71/3481/85/87).

Imposter syndrome: doubting an achieved success/promotion. Group left null on purpose (imposter appears in both Work & Career and Self & Meaning; a group constraint would wrongly penalize the decent Work imposter cards). Dimension-only boost lifts Confidence & Comparison cards (e.g. 49) and the dim-mismatch penalty drops the wrong lost-promotion cards.

triggers: ai is going to make my job
entries.note: Fear of AI/automation replacing one's job. Without this the bare 'work'/'job' cue and generic overwhelm push it to Work & Career burnout cards; this routes to the Modern Life AI/tech-anxiety cards (115/312/314/323).

triggers: everyone else has it figured out
entries.note: Feeling behind peers on life milestones (marriage/kids/houses). Group left null (spans Self/Work/Friendship/General); dimension boost surfaces the feeling-behind comparison cards (18/411/583) over friend-jealousy specifics.

triggers: compare myself to people at the gym
hate how my body looks compared
entries.note: Comparing one's body to others (body image). The words 'gym'/'body' otherwise route to overtraining/recovery cards; this surfaces Health & Body / Confidence & Comparison cards (3471/3566).
Doomscrolling (one word) isn't matched by the 'scroll'/'scrolling' triggers under word-boundary matching. Routes to the doomscrolling-fatigue card (4195).
Climate/eco-anxiety. Routes to the climate-helplessness card (388) instead of generic reorg/uncertainty cards.
Boundary-setting cue with no life area attached; it appears at work, at home and among friends, so the group must come from nearby triggers or retrieval.
